text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Forum of Federation is expected to adopt a coat of arms and a flag of the Federation on its today's session.
- Seven officers of the Federation Army are going to the United States for training.
- Danish Prime minister, Paul Rasmussen, visited Bosnia on Wednesday.
- The Federation government works on a draft of law which is due to return property, nationalized by Yugoslav authorities in 1945, to legal owners.
- Bosnian Federation Deputy Defense minister denies IFOR claims that the works on a road Sarajevo-Gorazde are completed.
- Ten Moslem houses were set on fire by Croats in Capljina region on Wednesday, eyewitnesses said.
- The city government of Mostar, comprising ten Croat and Moslem ministers, was elected on Wednesday.
